plain_text:
Pawtucket Redevelopment Agency 
Meeting Minutes 
September 8, 2026, 9:00 AM 
 
 
Call to Order  
The meeting was called to order at 9:00 a.m. 
 
Roll Call  
A quorum was established.  In attendance:  Larry Monastesse, Timothy O’Riley, Mark 
McLaughlin 
 
Others:  Jason Pezzullo, Timothy Chapman, Michael Cassidy, Mary Bourdeau, Jacob 
Alderman, Nico Corbo, Jeanne Boyle 
 
Public Input Session - None 
 
Executive Session 
Mr. O’Riley made a motion to go into Executive Session pursuant to R.I. Gen. L. § 42-46-
5(5), pertaining to discussions related to the disposition of publicly held property wherein 
advanced public information would be detrimental to the interest of the public – seconded by 
Mr. McLaughlin. The motion carried 3-0. 
 
The Agency convened in Executive Session to discuss the following matter: 
      
      • Conant Thread District 
 
 
Mr. O’Riley made a motion to seal the minutes of the executive session, seconded by Mr. 
McLaughlin.  Motion carried 3-0. 
 
Mr. O’Riley made a motion to return to Open Session, seconded by Mr. McLaughlin.  Motion 
carried 3-0. 
   
  
Upon returning to open session, the Chair reported that the Agency had voted to approve the 
preliminary award letter for the Conant Street property. 
 
Adjournment  
Mr. O’Riley made a motion to adjourn the meeting, seconded by Mr. McLaughlin.  The 
motion carried 3-0.
